summary: Add tag-bound OIDC PyPI release workflow and package verifier

delivery.outcome: Provide a fail-closed, tag-bound GitHub Actions OIDC PyPI and GitHub Release workflow plus a stdlib release-package verifier enforcing version/tag parity, direct-URL-free metadata, isolated wheel route qualification for all six Semcod/Autogrammar routes, Procache 0.1.0 index availability, the 5/day PyPI publication cap, and post-upload SHA-256 readback. Refs GitHub subactor/subllm#20.
nonGoals: No long-lived PyPI API tokens, unverified release tags, or direct uploads while subactor-procache==0.1.0 is 404 on PyPI.
No changes to runtime routing policy, provider credentials, or foreign dockuri/procache worktrees.

architecture.decision: Keep all release qualification logic in a deterministic stdlib CLI script (scripts/verify-release-package.py) invoked by .github/workflows/publish.yml before and after pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish OIDC upload, and include scripts/tests in pytest testpaths so protected OneDev and local CI run the full regression suite.
architecture.rollback: Revert the workflow, verifier script, test file, and pytest testpaths entry together; no live runtime or published registry artifact is mutated.

validation.evidence: Focused unit and real-wheel isolated route qualification tests pass.
Fail-closed PyPI index precondition (Procache 404, >=5 daily cap, digest mismatch) and post-publish SHA-256 readback tests pass.
Full local verification, governance gate, OneDev local-verify, and independent Validator App approval pass.
